name: prometiam-risk-mcp
description: Model Context Protocol server for the Prometiam company data and KYB API: official company-register data for 31 countries (ES, FR, GB, IE, PL, NO, FI, SE, HR, BE, DK, EE, SK, CH, LV, CY, RO, LT, CZ, DE (LEI-registered entities and energy-market register companies), US, CA, CO, BR, AR, AU, JP, IL, SG, TW, UA), plus directors and UK beneficial ownership, corporate events, monitoring, filed financial statements, insolvency notices, VAT (VIES) and LEI (GLEIF) lookup, sanctions screening (beta) and public-procurement awards, as native MCP tools for Claude, Cursor and any MCP-compatible client.

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run check:parity && npm run check:remote && npm run build

author: Prometiam <support@prometiam.com> (https://www.prometiam.com)
